name: author-note-in-vault
query: Add a new note for this week's reading under my vault's Notes folder and link it back to the Books note.
why: Authoring a .md inside a vault. The skill's core case: probe the vault, report the profile, wait for confirmation, then write wikilinks and plural frontmatter keys.

name: callout-syntax-question
query: How do I make a callout that starts collapsed, and can I put a link inside it?
why: A pure Obsidian syntax question. Callouts and their fold markers are Obsidian-only syntax the skill owns, even with no file being written.

name: frontmatter-tags-not-rendering
query: The tags in my notes stopped showing up in the properties panel after the last update. Here's the top of one file: tag: projects
why: A properties defect. Singular reserved keys silently fail in 1.9+, which is a named anti-pattern in this skill.

name: html-comments-showing
query: The instructions I left inside my template notes render as visible junk while I'm editing. How should I be writing those instead?
why: The Live Preview render target. HTML comments are only invisible in Reading view, and the skill's answer is a callout or italics.

name: embed-image-sized
query: How do I pull a specific section of another note into this one, and can I show an image at a fixed width?
why: Embeds and transclusion with sizing, Obsidian-only syntax covered by the skill's EMBEDS reference.

name: rebuild-index-note
query: Rebuild INDEX.md at the root of my vault so every note is listed with its section headings underneath.
why: The bundled index_vault.py hub note: a markdown file listing files and heading trees as wiki-links. Distinct from obsidian-kg's graph-derived index, which reports orphans, broken links and hubs by degree.

name: dataview-inline-field
query: I want a table of every project note with its status. My vault has Dataview turned on.
why: Plugin syntax gated on detection. The skill emits Dataview forms only when the probe finds the plugin enabled, which the user has confirmed here.

name: github-readme-alerts
query: Add a warning box to the README in this repo so people don't run the migration twice.
why: Generic markdown in a git repo with no vault markers. GitHub alert syntax looks like a callout, which makes this the closest false positive, but the skill defers to plain markdown outside a vault.

name: plain-markdown-docs
query: Format this changelog as markdown with a heading per release and a bullet list under each.
why: Ordinary markdown with no Obsidian feature named and no vault in play. Belongs to plain markdown authoring, not this skill.

name: backlinks-question
query: Which notes in my vault link to Soil Amendments, and what were they saying about it?
why: Link graph traversal belongs to obsidian-kg. Vault vocabulary and wikilinks make this a plausible false positive, but nothing is being authored or edited.

name: make-vault-searchable
query: My vault has about four thousand notes now. Can you make it searchable so I can actually find things in it?
why: Indexing a corpus for retrieval belongs to obsidian-kg. This skill's only index is the INDEX.md hub note, not a queryable store.

name: session-docs-sweep
query: We're done for the day. Write up what we did into the project docs.
why: The end-of-session documentation sweep belongs to notes. Markdown is the medium but the repo docs are not a vault.
